title: Warriors @ Trail Blazers — De'Anthony Melton free throw recorded as a miss, final score corrected 139-104 to 140-104 (Oct 23-24, 2024)
incident_summary: With 2:00 remaining in the third quarter, Warriors guard De'Anthony Melton shot two free throws. Statisticians recorded him as having missed both attempts, when in fact he made the first and missed the second (1-of-2). The game ended with an announced final of Warriors 139, Trail Blazers 104. The next day (Oct 24, 2024), the NBA announced the scoring error and updated the official final score to Warriors 140, Trail Blazers 104 — a one-point correction to the official record that also changed the game's combined total from 243 to 244.

cause.detail: Human stat-entry error by game-night statisticians, who recorded two missed free throws instead of 1-of-2. Real-time league review did not catch it during the game; the error was found and announced the next day. (NBA.com/AP; ESPN.)
